messages:
ryan: Quick sync request. We're testing the attribution-hold flow but hit two compatibility issues with downstream billing exporters and quota enforcers. Wanted a short thread to align on fixes.

ashish: TL;DR what broke?

ryan: 1) billing exporter dedupe expects final writes only; provisional upserts caused a rare duplicate invoice line when TTL expired right before export. 2) quota enforcer reads the serving routing decision to decrement project quota; when attribution reassigns later, project quota didn't get credited back.

katie: Ouch. For (1) can we add an export-time de-dup key based on request_id + provisional_flag? Exporter can drop lines where final write later arrived within Xs.

ashish: Exporter change is doable but needs cross-team coordination. For (2) quota enforcer change is trickier since it's latency sensitive. We don't want to add wait to serve path. Options: a) emit compensating quota-credit event when reattribute occurs, b) use a write-behind counter in billing buffer that supports upsert semantics for quotas as well. Thoughts?

ryan: I prefer (a) compensating event; simpler and auditable. We also need a metric `attribution.compensations` and an alert if rate > threshold.

katie: Agree on compensations. We also need console UX to show "Quota impact pending" so support isn't surprised. Small pink badge maybe.

ashish: Implementation notes: when provisional write is emitted, quota enforcer decrements org quota. If final attribution to project arrives within TTL, emit `quota.compensate` for org and `quota.decrement` for project. Add `max_compensations_per_min` guard.

devops-bot: feature flag `attribution-hold-compat-fix` created and scheduled to staging at 2024-09-01T02:00Z.

finance: From billing perspective we need invariants: invoices must be idempotent. If exporter dedup is required, set policy that provisional writes must be tagged and removed if final arrived before export window. We'll review export window docs.

ryan: Action list:
- ashish: implement compensating quota events + metrics (ETA 2d)
- katie: console badge + tooltip copy and small support doc (ETA 2d)
- finance: review exporter dedupe policy and confirm tolerance for provisional writes (ETA 3d)
- ryan: add e2e canary that simulates export during TTL edgecases

ashish: Also adding telemetry: `attribution.timing_ms`, `attribution.compensations`, `quota.compensation_failures`. Tag by org/project.

katie: UX copy draft: "Attribution pending  We applied a fallback to keep latency low; final billing and quota assignment may update shortly." Will post mock in #design later.

ryan: Plan: deploy flag to staging, run synthetic canary covering both export and quota timing edges, then a 1% prod canary. If finance ok, widen.

devops-bot: staged flag enabled at 2024-09-01T02:00Z (by infra).
